newsitem.title: RUSSIA: SOCCER-HOLDERS LOKOMOTIV MOSCOW THROUGH TO SEMIFINALS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-HOLDERS LOKOMOTIV MOSCOW THROUGH TO SEMIFINALS.

text.p: Holders Lokomotiv Moscow booked the last remaining Russian Cup semifinal berth on Wednesday, two late goals earning them a 2-1 away win over capital rivals Torpedo.

The state railways club, who beat champions Spartak Moscow in last year's final to claim their first trophy for four decades, will face Krylya Sovietov Samara in next week's semifinal. Samara beat Rotor Volgograd 1-0 at home on Tuesday.
The second semifinal will pit Zenit St Petersburg, quarter-final victors over Spartak, against premier league leaders Dynamo Moscow.
